The fluorescent lights of the office hummed with the same low-grade anxiety that had been building in Arthur’s chest since 8:00 AM. It was "Bring Your Pet to Work Day," a corporate initiative designed to boost morale, which Arthur had interpreted as a chance to show off his prize-winning African Grey parrot, Barnaby.

Arthur had spent the morning whispering to Barnaby in the breakroom, thinking the bird was just mimicking the sound of his voice. He was wrong. Barnaby had been listening to Arthur’s encrypted calls with the regional manager, calls Arthur thought were secure because he was standing in the soundproofed glass booth.

"Good morning, Arthur," said Brenda from HR, walking by with a tray of muffins. "How’s the new employee doing?"

Arthur smiled tightly. "He’s... adjusting. Very vocal."

Barnaby puffed his feathers. "Quarterly earnings down twelve percent," he squawked, perfectly mimicking Arthur’s stressed baritone from yesterday’s call.

Brenda froze. The muffin tin clattered to the floor. "Excuse me?"

Arthur’s heart stopped. "He’s just... practicing! For a play! A corporate satire!"

"Did he just say earnings are down?" Brenda asked, her eyes narrowing.

"No! He’s confused! He thinks we’re a bakery!" Arthur lunged for Barnaby, who was now perched on the edge of the conference table.

"Insider trading is a felony," Barnaby added, tilting his head. "Also, the CEO is embezzling funds via shell companies in the Caymans."

The office went silent. The entire floor had stopped typing.

Arthur grabbed a stack of confidential files and threw them over Barnaby. "He’s lying! He’s a liar! He’s been watching too much news!"

Barnaby shook off the papers. "Arthur is wearing a fake watch. It’s a replica. Also, the server room password is 'password123'."

Arthur’s face went pale. He had used that password for his personal email, which he definitely shouldn’t have used for work.

Brenda pulled out her phone. "I’m calling security. And legal."

"No!" Arthur cried, diving onto the table. "It’s a prank! A very elaborate, very dangerous prank!"
